recommendedNextBatch.outcome: Make B01-B05 contracts accurately consumable by later engineering without activating Forms, Flow, Discord, registration, support, insurance, warranty, or resources.

items.title: Additive registration evidence migration
acceptanceEvidence: Registration contract and schema add purchase-evidence and first-use-evidence collections.
serialNumber is retained as nullable legacyPhysicalSerialEvidence and is no longer a normal duplicate key.
One customer can reference multiple immutable per-machine registration records.
Missing evidence produces human review and never automatic denial.
All historical B02 tests remain passing with additive migration tests.
items.activationBoundary: Synthetic records only; no Shopify Forms, metafield, customer, or live registration mutation.

items.title: Support, safety, and notification contract amendment
acceptanceEvidence: Hours encode Monday-Friday 09:00-17:00 America/Chicago with no response guarantee.
Stephanie recovery, staff-owner resolution, Kevin-authorized reopen, Kevin primary safety, and Warehouse fallback are represented as roles without inventing production identities.
SAFETY_HOLD remains private and requires authorized evidence-backed disposition.
Manufacturer referral retains Rhino ownership and follow-up and contains no private destination value.
Notification recovery and reopen transition tests pass.
items.activationBoundary: No real routing destination, email, Discord webhook, referral, refund, or customer message.

items.title: Non-publishable warranty intent contract
acceptanceEvidence: One-year machine and durable-part duration, wear-arrival limit, registration trigger, remedy allocation, and prior-purchase exception intent are versioned.
Legal applicability, agreement verification, and customer copy remain separate false gates.
Missing purchase evidence cannot issue an automatic denial.
No operational warranty decision or customer notification becomes available.
items.activationBoundary: Internal business-intent configuration only; no warranty publication or eligibility automation.

items.title: Exact 31-Product coverage review projection
acceptanceEvidence: Projection contains exactly the 31 HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED rows from the coverage matrix.
Every exact Product and Variant GID is unchanged.
Avery or Veronica records evidence and a business mapping per row.
No mapping sets customerPromiseAuthorized or substitutes Shopify Vendor for evidence.
items.activationBoundary: Business mapping review only; legal approval and customer coverage remain false.

items.title: Resource administration interface
acceptanceEvidence: B05's nine candidates import without approval or publication.
Product Owner can assign document/video links to exact Product, Variant, and machine versions.
Updates create immutable revisions and retain supersession history.
Existing Kevin approval is recorded against exact revision evidence without demanding a blanket re-review.
Customer release remains a separate disabled action.
items.activationBoundary: Private administration with synthetic or repository evidence only; no resource delivery or storefront publication.

items.title: Basic-plan Forms-to-case proof of concept
acceptanceEvidence: Non-production proof verifies Forms submission metaobject visibility and event/API behavior.
A minimal private app creates an opaque case and append-only case-event records in Shopify-owned storage or documents why compatible external storage is required.
Status, assignment, notes/evidence references, resolution, Kevin-authorized reopen, access checks, notification ledger, and durable history are demonstrated.
Failure and duplicate tests are preserved.
items.activationBoundary: No production installation, active form, real customer data, or live staff notification.

items.title: Exact staff identity and permission audit
acceptanceEvidence: Warehouse, Stephanie, Kevin, assigned employees, and designated mailbox map to exact current identities.
Customer, Content/metaobject, Forms, Flow, Files, export, deletion, app, and secret permissions are recorded with least privilege.
Primary and fallback routes are tested without exposing private destinations.
items.activationBoundary: Read-only audit and role proposal; no permission or account changes.

items.title: Redacted Discord alert adapter
acceptanceEvidence: Alert is created only after a durable case record exists.
Payload is limited to opaque case ID, severity, state, and authenticated internal link.
Test proves testimony, images, addresses, contact details, evidence, and credentials cannot enter payloads.
Delivery failure creates a recoverable notification-ledger event and never closes a case.
items.activationBoundary: Synthetic webhook endpoint only until security review and explicit live configuration authorization.

items.title: Seven-year export, backup, deletion, and restore design
acceptanceEvidence: All registration, case, evidence, event, notification, audit, and resource classes are exportable.
Restore verification, backup encryption/access, deletion disposition, open-case hold, and legal exceptions are specified.
Shopify activity log is not used as the durable seven-year history.
items.activationBoundary: Design and synthetic export/restore proof only; no real customer export or deletion.

items.title: Silica-Gem operating procedure confirmation
acceptanceEvidence: Acknowledgement, customer communication, non-acknowledgement escalation, Rhino follow-up, and return-to-Rhino conditions are recorded.
Refund liability and repair allocation match the compatible operating agreement.
Restricted contact destinations are provided through approved secret configuration.
items.activationBoundary: No referral, refund, or private destination configuration before confirmation.

items.title: Cart insurance and carrier compatibility assessment
acceptanceEvidence: Carrier/provider, eligibility, price, terms, claims, taxes, discounts, cancellation, refund, and order persistence are verified.
The existing quote request checkbox is distinguished from a binding selection.
The owner chooses request-for-quote or paid protection after the assessment.
Cart, quote, pickup, mobile, accessibility, and checkout-entry regressions are defined.
items.activationBoundary: Assessment only; no product, charge, protection promise, app, cart, or checkout change.

items.title: Operational acceptance and release gate
acceptanceEvidence: Compatible operating agreement exists.
Exact policy and customer-message versions, effective date, legal compatibility, and Product coverage approvals exist.
Named operational acceptance owner approves tested staff workflows and recovery.
Product Owner gives final release authorization.
items.activationBoundary: This backlog does not satisfy or authorize the release gate.
